name: The Show Must Go Out
source:
Your friend sets you up on a blind date with a "mystery man" at an elegant theater. Everything seems perfect, but when an explosion shakes up the place, your romantic evening turns into an action-filled chase between your date and his nemesis... And they won't stop making musical theater references?!

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/the-show-must-go-out]itch.io[/url]]
